banner.title: Your account isn't ready to receive bookings yet
banner.subtitle: Complete these steps to start receiving clients.
banner.dismissedHint: You can resume the setup at any time from the system settings.

welcome.title: Welcome to AppointMePro
welcome.body: Let's set up your account in 5 steps. You can close this wizard and resume at any time.

availability.title: Step 1: Weekly schedule
availability.description: Define which days and hours you work. Unchecked days will be considered non-working.

service.title: Step 3: First service
service.description: Services are what your clients book (with duration and price).

rules.title: Step 4: Booking rules
rules.description: Set the minimum notice for booking and cancelling.

contact.title: Step 5: Contact information
contact.description: Phone, email, address and map location so clients can find you.

done.title: All set!
done.body: Your account is now operational. You can keep configuring from the side menu.
